methodology: Reviewed forensics profile + public docs. Exponent is a yield/points-trading protocol with interest-rate markets, not an order-matched perpetual DEX.

evidence.architecturalNote: Exponent runs yield and point markets. Users take leveraged positions on yield/points rather than placing matched orders against other users. There is no haircut-residual socialisation surface in the Percolator F7 sense.
evidence.programImmutable: Exponent Core program is IMMUTABLE (no upgrade authority). Any F7-class vulnerability in the matching logic cannot be hotfixed if found.

findings.hasSocialisation: unclear - if a counterparty can't pay, losses may flow to LP vault (pool absorption model) rather than via F7-style residual
findings.classification: GREEN (likely, pending deeper review - not a matched-order perp architecture)
findings.confidence: medium - architecture is yield/points, not traditional perps

notes: Protocol Core is IMMUTABLE. Any structural defence (or absence) is permanent.
Worth a deeper review of yield/points specific attack surfaces (oracle manipulation on yield indexes, point-allocation race conditions) but those are not F7-class.
